title: Sankey diagram
description: Flows between stages: energy balances, user journeys, budget allocations. Nodes sit in columns, the thickness of a link is proportional to its flow, and the node order is relaxed to straighten the flows and avoid crossings. Hover a node to highlight all its flows, or a link to see it as a share of its source; the arrow keys walk through the nodes and links.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: labels
props.description: Node labels (name and value; default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: labelValues
props.description: Shows the value after the name in the labels (default `true`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: links
props.description: Flows between the nodes (by name or index); links closing a cycle are ignored

props.name: nodes
props.description: Nodes, in their initial order; nodes only named by a link are appended

props.name: align
props.description: Column of the nodes without a `column` (default `justify`)

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Width of the node bars, in pixels (default 12)

props.name: nodePadding
props.description: Vertical gap between the nodes of a column, in pixels (default 12)

props.name: iterations
props.description: Relaxation passes that straighten the flows and reduce crossings (default 32)

props.name: linkOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the links, 0-1 (default 0.4)

props.name: linkColor
props.description: Color of the links without `color` (default `gradient`)

<script setup lang="ts">
// Energy flows from the sources to the uses through the grid: link
// thickness is the flow, colored from the source to the target.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { SankeyChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const NODES = {
  en: [
    "Solar",
    "Wind",
    "Gas",
    "Grid",
    "Homes",
    "Industry",
    "Transport",
    "Losses",
  ],
  zh: ["太阳能", "风能", "天然气", "电网", "居民", "工业", "交通", "损耗"],
  ja: ["太陽光", "風力", "ガス", "送電網", "家庭", "産業", "運輸", "損失"],
  fr: [
    "Solaire",
    "Éolien",
    "Gaz",
    "Réseau",
    "Foyers",
    "Industrie",
    "Transports",
    "Pertes",
  ],
};

// source, target (node indexes), TWh
const LINKS = [
  [0, 3, 32],
  [1, 3, 48],
  [2, 3, 70],
  [3, 4, 52],
  [3, 5, 61],
  [3, 6, 22],
  [3, 7, 15],
].map(([source, target, value]) => ({ source, target, value }));

const { language } = useI18n();
const nodes = computed(() =>
  (NODES[language.value] ?? NODES.en).map((name) => ({ name })),
);
const format = (value: number) => `${value} TWh`;
</script>

<template>
  <SankeyChart :nodes="nodes" :links="LINKS" :format="format" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// A user journey with drop-offs: `align="left"` keeps every step in its
// column, `link-color="source"` colors a flow like the page it leaves.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { SankeyChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const STEPS = {
  en: ["Home page", "Search", "Product page", "Cart", "Checkout", "Left"],
  zh: ["首页", "搜索", "商品页", "购物车", "结账", "离开"],
  ja: ["トップページ", "検索", "商品ページ", "カート", "購入手続き", "離脱"],
  fr: ["Accueil", "Recherche", "Fiche produit", "Panier", "Paiement", "Départ"],
};

// from, to (step indexes), visitors
const FLOWS = [
  [0, 1, 420],
  [0, 2, 310],
  [0, 5, 270],
  [1, 2, 330],
  [1, 5, 90],
  [2, 3, 380],
  [2, 5, 260],
  [3, 4, 240],
  [3, 5, 140],
].map(([source, target, value]) => ({ source, target, value }));

const { language } = useI18n();
const nodes = computed(() =>
  (STEPS[language.value] ?? STEPS.en).map((name, i) => ({
    name,
    ...(i === 5 ? { color: "var(--text-secondary-color, #9ca3af)" } : {}),
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <SankeyChart :nodes="nodes" :links="FLOWS" align="left" link-color="source" />
</template>

translationResources.title: Sankey diagram
translationResources.description: Flows between stages: energy balances, user journeys, budget allocations. Nodes sit in columns, the thickness of a link is proportional to its flow, and the node order is relaxed to straighten the flows and avoid crossings. Hover a node to highlight all its flows, or a link to see it as a share of its source; the arrow keys walk through the nodes and links.

energy.title: Energy flow
energy.description: Primary sources, carriers and end uses of a national energy balance. Each node has a color, and the links fade from the source color to the target color; format adds the unit to the labels and the tooltip.

journey.title: User journey
journey.description: Where the sessions of a week come from and where they end. align="left" keeps the visitors who leave next to the pages they left from, linkColor="source" colors each path by its channel, and onClick reports a node or a link (with its source and target).

budget.title: Budget allocation
budget.description: Revenue streams fund a budget split between departments and programs. linkColor="target" colors each flow by where the money goes; a currency format in the reader's locale shortens the amounts.

options.title: Alignment and colors
options.description: The chatbot solves tickets without a support tier, so its flows skip a column. align decides where the nodes without explicit column go, linkColor how the links are painted, and labelValues whether the labels show the values.

income-statement.title: Income statement
income-statement.description: Revenue segments flow into revenue, then split into costs and profit down to net income. Each link sets its own color (green for profit, red for costs) while the segments keep linkColor="source"; a compact currency format shortens the amounts.

supply-chain.title: Supply chain tracing
supply-chain.description: Coffee from the origins to the sales channels. onClick on a node keeps every path through it in color and grays out the other links through their color; a link is selected alone, with its share of the source.

hiring-funnel.title: Hiring funnel
hiring-funnel.description: Candidates from their source to a hire, with the drop-offs at each stage. Links refer to the nodes by name, so the switch simply leaves the drop-off nodes and links out; align="left" keeps each drop-off next to its stage.

live-traffic.title: Live API traffic
live-traffic.description: Requests per second from the clients to the services and their status codes, refreshed every 1.5 s. The flows are computed downstream so that every node receives what it sends, and iterations={0} keeps the nodes in place between updates.

plastic.title: Plastic packaging flows
plastic.description: Polymers placed on the market and where the packaging ends up. renderTooltip shows a link as a share of its source (percent) and a node as a share of all the packaging.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Revenue streams flowing into the annual budget and out to the departments; press a node or a flow to highlight it, a tap calls onClick.

data.tapHint: Tap a department or a flow to select it

SankeyChartProps.nodes: Nodes in their initial order (name, color, optional column); nodes only named by a link are appended
SankeyChartProps.links: Flows between two nodes, given by name or by index; links that would close a cycle are ignored
SankeyChartProps.nodeWidth: Width of the node bars, in pixels
SankeyChartProps.nodePadding: Vertical gap between the nodes of a column, in pixels (reduced when space is short)
SankeyChartProps.align: Column of the nodes without column: justify puts the sinks last, left / right align on the sources / sinks, center puts the sources next to their first target
SankeyChartProps.iterations: Relaxation passes that move the nodes toward their neighbours to straighten the flows and reduce crossings
SankeyChartProps.linkColor: Color of the links without color: gradient from the source to the target, one of the two, or neutral gray
SankeyChartProps.linkOpacity: Opacity of the links from 0 to 1; hovered flows are more opaque
SankeyChartProps.labels: Shows the node labels (name and value); overlapping labels are skipped
SankeyChartProps.labelValues: Shows the value after the name in the labels

SankeyNode.name: Name shown in the label and the tooltip; links can refer to the node by this name
SankeyNode.color: Color of the node and of the ends of its links; taken from the palette when omitted
SankeyNode.column: Column of the node (0 = leftmost); computed from the links when omitted

SankeyLink.source: Source node: its name, or its index in nodes
SankeyLink.target: Target node: its name, or its index in nodes
SankeyLink.value: Size of the flow (negative values count as 0)
SankeyLink.color: Color of the flow; follows linkColor when omitted
